scope: Primary-paper research only; no repository analysis or benchmark reproduction.
search_strategy: Search arXiv for requested seed papers, information bottleneck and rate-distortion compression.
Follow primary citations on task-aware compression, learned latent interfaces, context evaluation, and memory.
Search for 2026 compression evaluation and memory work; inspect selected full methods/evaluations.
Verify revision histories directly from arXiv and pin claims to selected revisions.
excluded_evidence: No third-party summaries, repository-local claims, dependency rankings, or current pricing.
known_ambiguities: TALE v5 Table 3 caption disagrees with its average row and task count.
MemFly was renamed MemCoRe; old-version result headlines must not be mixed with v3 tables.
Selective Context precursor and EMNLP-era paper use different arXiv identifiers.
Compression speedup is sensitive to model/server/cache/output-length baselines.

P16 abstract/body timing metrics differ; one-token compressor-inclusive TTFT is not full-generation latency. Reader-reported 43%/53%/64% and Figure 2/Section 4.4 could not be reproduced in retrieved v1 HTML/PDF (Figure 3/Section 4.5).

sources.title_at_retrieval: Prompt Compression in the Wild: Measuring Latency, Rate Adherence, and Quality for Faster LLM Inference
sources.inspected_sections: Abstract; Section 4.2 one-token TTFT setup and serving/API comparison; memory discussion. Retrieved HTML/PDF label the TTFT plot Figure 3 and memory Section 4.5; reader reports Figure 2/Section 4.4.
sources.narrow_claim: Mistral-7B/Transformers 3-4x is compressor-inclusive TTFT for one-token output, prompts >2000 tokens and compression >=5x, not full-generation/task latency. No reliable TTFT speedup was reported for the tested GPT-3.5 Turbo/GPT-4o mini API setups.
sources.limitations: Historical setup-specific TTFT evidence. Abstract 18% end-to-end headline is not reconciled with body TTFT factors. Reader-reported 43% TTFT gain and 53%/64% aggregate GPU-memory increases were not found in the retrieved v1 HTML/PDF; conditions, memory scope, and representation mismatch remain unresolved.
